```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggsankeyfier)
library(patchwork)
library(magick)
library(grid)
library(ggtext)
```

Figure 1 Panel B - Sankey plot
```{r}
## Load patient sequencing strategy
metadata <- readxl::read_xlsx("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/sample_method.xlsx") %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(method = ifelse(method == "WGA", "scWGS", method))
metadata$group <- factor(x = metadata$group, levels = c("UC2", "UC4", "UC5", "UC7", "UC10", "UC11", "UC13", "UC14", "UC18", "UC19", "UC26", "UC34"))
metadata$type <- factor(x = metadata$type, levels = c("T", "N", "B", "BF", "U"))
metadata$method <- factor(x = metadata$method, levels = c("WGS", "DS", "scWGS"))

## Convert data into ggsankeyfier formating
pd <- metadata %>% mutate(flow = n()) %>%
  pivot_stages_longer(c("group", "type", "method"), "flow", "type")

## Factor order
all.levels <- c("UC2", "UC4", "UC5", "UC7", "UC10", "UC11", "UC13", "UC14", "UC18", "UC19", "UC26", "UC34", "T", "N", "B", "BF", "U", "WGS", "DS", "scWGS")

pd$node <- factor(x = pd$node, levels = rev(all.levels))

## Manual override of ggsankey format. Prevent duplicate flow because more than 1 sequencing method
for(n in 1:nrow(pd)) {
  print(n)
  what.stage <- as.character(pd[n,"stage"][[1]])
  what.edge <- as.numeric(pd[n,"edge_id"])
  if(what.stage == "group") {
    what.flow <- as.numeric(pd[n, "flow"])
    if(what.flow == 134) {
      pd[n, "flow"] <- 134/2
      pd[which(pd$edge_id == what.edge & pd$stage == "type"), "flow"] <- as.numeric(pd[which(pd$edge_id == what.edge & pd$stage == "type"), "flow"]) / 2
    }
  } else {
    next
  }
}

# tumor
pd[which(pd$connector == "from" & pd$edge_id == "41"), "flow"] <- as.numeric(pd[which(pd$connector == "to" & pd$edge_id == "41"), "flow"]) / 2
pd[which(pd$connector == "to" & pd$edge_id == "41"), "flow"] <- as.numeric(pd[which(pd$connector == "to" & pd$edge_id == "41"), "flow"]) / 2
pd[which(pd$connector == "from" & pd$edge_id == "40"), "flow"] <- as.numeric(pd[which(pd$connector == "to" & pd$edge_id == "40"), "flow"]) / 2
pd[which(pd$connector == "to" & pd$edge_id == "40"), "flow"] <- as.numeric(pd[which(pd$connector == "to" & pd$edge_id == "40"), "flow"]) / 2
## normal
pd[which(pd$connector == "from" & pd$edge_id == "42"), "flow"] <- as.numeric(pd[which(pd$connector == "to" & pd$edge_id == "42"), "flow"]) / 2
pd[which(pd$connector == "to" & pd$edge_id == "42"), "flow"] <- as.numeric(pd[which(pd$connector == "to" & pd$edge_id == "42"), "flow"]) / 2
pd[which(pd$connector == "from" & pd$edge_id == "43"), "flow"] <- as.numeric(pd[which(pd$connector == "to" & pd$edge_id == "43"), "flow"]) / 2
pd[which(pd$connector == "to" & pd$edge_id == "43"), "flow"] <- as.numeric(pd[which(pd$connector == "to" & pd$edge_id == "43"), "flow"]) / 2
##bf
pd[which(pd$connector == "from" & pd$edge_id == "45"), "flow"] <- round(42.63636 * 7)
pd[which(pd$connector == "from" & pd$edge_id == "46"), "flow"] <- round(42.63636 * 4)
pd[which(pd$connector == "to" & pd$edge_id == "45"), "flow"] <- round(42.63636 * 7)
pd[which(pd$connector == "to" & pd$edge_id == "46"), "flow"] <- round(42.63636 * 4)

## Color annotation
cols2 <- c(rep("transparent", times = 12), "#2F6DAE", "#F2C94C", "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#D55E00", rep("transparent", times = 3))
names(cols2) <- all.levels

## Plot sankey
p <- ggplot(pd,
       aes(x = stage, y = flow, group = node, connector = connector,
           edge_id = edge_id))

pos <- position_sankey(v_space = "auto", align = "justify", order = "as_is", width = 0.18)#, order = "descending")

p10 <- p + geom_sankeyedge(aes(fill = type), position = pos, alpha = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_sankeynode(position = pos, aes(fill = node)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = node), stat = "sankeynode", position = pos, size = 1.8) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.05, 0.05)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

Figure 1 Panel A (Right)
```{r}
## Load patient meta data
patientdata <- readxl::read_xlsx("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/patientinfo.xlsx")

#########
## Age ##

## Age: continuous to discrete
age_cat <- cut(
  patientdata$Age,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 49, 70, Inf),
  labels = c("<50", "50–70", "70+")
)

## Append to patientdata df
patientdata$age_cat <- age_cat

## Col annotation
age_cols <- c(
  "<50" = "#FFF9C4",
  "50–70" = "#F4E27A",
  "70+"   = "#D68D00"
)

# Plot data
pd <- patientdata %>% dplyr::count(age_cat)
 
# Compute percentages
pd$fraction = pd$n / sum(pd$n)

# Compute the cumulative percentages (top of each rectangle)
pd$ymax = cumsum(pd$fraction)

# Compute the bottom of each rectangle
pd$ymin = c(0, head(pd$ymax, n=-1))

# Compute label position
pd$labelPosition <- (pd$ymax + pd$ymin) / 2

# Redesign labels
pd$label <- paste0("<b>", pd$age_cat, "</b><br>", round(pd$fraction * 100, 1), "%")

## Plot age donut plot
p11 <- ggplot(pd, aes(ymax=ymax, ymin=ymin, xmax=5, xmin=3, fill=age_cat)) +
  geom_rect() +
  geom_richtext(x = 5.2, aes(y = labelPosition, label = label), size = 1.6, color = "black",
                family = "Arial", fill = NA, label.color = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = age_cols) +
  coord_polar(theta="y", clip = "off") +
  xlim(0, 5) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "Age", 
           color = "black", size = 1.8) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        aspect.ratio = NULL,         # keeps plot square and centered
        plot.margin = margin(-20, -20, -20, -20))  # reduce empty space

#################
## Cancer type ##
pd.cancer <- patientdata %>% dplyr::count(`Tumor Site`)
 
# Compute percentages
pd.cancer$fraction = pd.cancer$n / sum(pd.cancer$n)

# Compute the cumulative percentages (top of each rectangle)
pd.cancer$ymax = cumsum(pd.cancer$fraction)

# Compute the bottom of each rectangle
pd.cancer$ymin = c(0, head(pd.cancer$ymax, n=-1))

# Compute label position
pd.cancer$labelPosition <- (pd.cancer$ymax + pd.cancer$ymin) / 2

# Redesign labels
pd.cancer$label <- paste0("<b>", pd.cancer$`Tumor Site`, "</b><br>", round(pd.cancer$fraction * 100, 1), "%")

## Col annotation
cancer_cols <- c(
  "Kidney" = "#7E57C2",
  "Bladder" = "#EF4444",
  "Ureter" = "#7C4B0D",
  "Kidney/Ureter" = "#506A51"
)

## Plot cancer type donut plot
p12 <- ggplot(pd.cancer, aes(ymax=ymax, ymin=ymin, xmax=5, xmin=3, fill=`Tumor Site`)) +
  geom_rect() +
  # geom_text(x = 5.2, aes(y = labelPosition, label = label), size = 1.6, color = "black", family = "Arial") +
  geom_richtext(x = 5.2, aes(y = labelPosition, label = label), size = 1.6, color = "black",
                family = "Arial", fill = NA, label.color = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cancer_cols) +
  coord_polar(theta="y", clip = "off") +
  xlim(0, 5) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "Cancer", 
           color = "black", size = 1.8) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        aspect.ratio = NULL,         # keeps plot square and centered
        plot.margin = margin(-20, -20, -20, -20))  # reduce empty space

## Combine the two donut plots together
pie_combined <- p11 / p12 +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)) + theme(plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0))
```

## Figure 1 Panel A (left)
```{r}
# Read image
img <- image_read("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/Fig1A_left.png")

# Convert to raster grob
img_grob <- rasterGrob(
  image = as.raster(img),
  interpolate = TRUE
)

# Turn into a ggplot object
img_plot <- ggplot() +
  annotation_custom(img_grob, xmin=-Inf, xmax=Inf, ymin=-Inf, ymax=Inf) +
  theme_void()
```

Figure to Panel using patchwork
```{r}
layout <- "
AAAABCCC
AAAABCCC
ZZZZZZZZ
ZZZZZZZZ
ZZZZZZZZ
ZZZZZZZZ
ZZZZZZZZ
ZZZZZZZZ"

combined_plot1 <- img_plot + free(wrap_elements(pie_combined)) + p10 + plot_layout(design=layout) + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("A", "", "B"))) &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = 'bold', size = 10),
        text = element_text(family = "Arial"))

ggsave("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/figure/figure1.png", 
       width = 170, height = 170,
       units = "mm", dpi = 600)
```
